stations.title: Your constructors
stations.gap: A booking can be half filled in

captions: Bookings for the Gannet. Bridie wants to know why a family was left on the quay.
The booking was made in steps, and the line for the seats was never written.
You write constructors that make a booking whole, and a method that moves it.
Now no booking can exist without its passenger, seats and hour.
Constructors, this and default values. Next: fields nobody outside can change.
